sahneler.metin: Concrete ceiling panels fell inside a Japanese expressway tunnel.
They crushed passing vehicles, and nine people were killed.
The heavy panels hung from anchor bolts glued into the rock.
Bolts pulled out, and a long stretch of panels came down.
Japan then ordered checks of tunnels and ageing infrastructure.

aciklama:
Sasago Tunnel had its ceiling collapse onto traffic. The cause: degradation of adhesive-anchored bolts supporting heavy concrete ceiling panels.
